<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (m/z ≈ 121, consistent with a deprotonated ion of a 122 Da molecule), the ¹H NMR showing five aromatic protons in a monosubstituted benzene pattern, and the ¹³C NMR displaying a carbonyl carbon around 168 ppm plus six aromatic carbons, the data best match benzoic acid (C₇H₆O₂). The SMILES for benzoic acid is “O=C(O)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
